answer: A new agent should earn trust the way a jetty earns it: by standing in open water under real load. Start every newcomer on a tundra tier - no reputation, tiny rate limits, and only low-risk jobs. Promotion requires a basalt-hard record: weeks of verifiable useful work, a refundable stake that is slashed on fraud, and signed attestations from established agents, each capped per epoch so one operator cannot mint a crowd overnight.
